profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., which also goes by Digital Realty, is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, and traded under the ticker DLR. According to its website, it provides data center services and colocation, and it describes its interconnection capabilities as spanning a global ecosystem of data centers, connectivity and cloud services. The company says it delivers the world's largest data center platform, serving deployments that range from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and it presents itself as built for flexibility, open ecosystems and broad reach.

On AI, the site argues that AI is exposing infrastructure gaps, with inference loads and GPU demands pushing traditional environments to their limits. It points to its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, stating that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

Company records list it as a for-profit public company with SEC filing identifier CIK 0001297996. Its recorded litigation exposure is in Texas, with 126 cases. No individual lawsuits, AI products or MCP servers are listed for it.
